text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswanan press on Wednesday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The Ministry of Commerce and Industry holds talks with the Information Trust Company about its trading licence.

- The government has in place all the relevant machinery for the restocking of Ngamiland farms where all cattle were slaughtered as part of a programme to eradicate cattle lung disease, says Marcus Chimbombi of the Ministry of Agriculture.
